title: App fast-path↔log convergence (E10) tested only for the harness producer; app.bin is built but never executed by any test
detail: The P0 replay invariant is proven for log-injection (unit) and the harness producer (lower_intents + floor(ms*hz/1000)+1), but handle_input — the only real interaction producer — is never executed: CI builds app.bin only, and nothing cross-checks app apply_tick = tick+1 against the harness convention.
recommended_fix: Add a core test emulating the fast-path (live apply + log apply_tick=tick+1, step with {}, then replay and assert identical hashes), or a CI step that runs app.bin with scripted input.

core/topology_test.odin:121-122 (the only snap test):
	testing.expect(t, dist2({0, 0}, {36, 0}) <= 36*36, "snap must be inclusive at the radius boundary (E4)")
	testing.expect(t, dist2({0, 0}, {37, 0}) > 36*36, "snap must exclude just past the radius (E4)")
detail: E4 is pinned only for core's grid-space dist2. The app's snap_node re-implements the metric in f64 world-px space (tile-scaled), with its own inclusive comparison and lower-id tie-break; it is the interaction gate (a draw commits only when snap succeeds) yet zero tests execute it.
recommended_fix: Extract snap to a pure function tested at: within/at/just-past radius in px space, and an exact-distance tie resolving to the lower node id.

at 500ms draw 0 1 standard

detail: All pinned vectors are d² = 0/25/144; the fixture and draw.dem draw axis-aligned 12-tile spans (d²=144). The bump branch (d2 - r*r > r) and isqrt(1)/large-x paths are never executed by any test, demo, or golden — the metric's only non-trivial logic is dead in test.
recommended_fix: Pin non-square vectors exercising the round-half-up branch (e.g. {0,0}→{1,1} = 2, {0,0}→{2,1} = 5, {0,0}→{1,0} = 1) plus a large-coordinate case.

title: 'A rejected draw mutates nothing' asserted for 3 of 5 rejection tests — unknown-tier and missing-node omit the pipe_count check
evidence:
core/topology_test.odin:67-77:
	_, err := topology_apply_edit(&s.topology, cmd_bad_tier, cat)
	testing.expect(t, err == .Unknown_Tier, "out-of-range tier must reject with .Unknown_Tier")
	// a node id that was never spawned
	cmd_missing := Command{apply_tick = 1, kind = Cmd_Draw_Pipe{a = res, b = 9999, tier = 0}}
	_, err2 := topology_apply_edit(&s.topology, cmd_missing, cat)
	testing.expect(t, err2 == .Missing_Node, "unknown node must reject with .Missing_Node")

(compare the pipe_count == 0 assertions at lines 29, 43, 58 of the same file)
detail: For two of the five rejection paths only the error enum is checked, not that the topology is untouched. Structurally guaranteed (validate_draw returns before any mutation), so low risk — but the story's 'rejected draw mutates nothing' contract is pinned 3/5.
recommended_fix: Add testing.expectf(t, pipe_count(&s.topology) == 0, ...) after the unknown-tier and missing-node cases.

title: W1 drift-check's six mutation classes are parse/header-level only; valid-parse payload drift is not generated, and replayed hashes are discarded
detail: All six classes fail at log_read or the header binding. A payload mutation that still parses and validates (e.g. tier 1→2 on a legal span) is not generated, and replay_hashes returns no manifest comparison, so drift-check would report it as 'gate accepted' rather than divergence. W1's CI claim is proven for the classes tested.
recommended_fix: Add a payload-level mutation class (flip a record field to another valid value) and assert rejection via hash divergence against the manifest, or route drift-check through verify_replay.

title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
detail: P0 = 100% (replay-equality over draw incl. non-vacuous asserts; binary-log round-trip + all rejections; T1/T2 byte-exact + replay gate in CI; W1 drift-check in CI, 11/11 rejections). P1 = 80%: topology 90% (5/5 paths, mutates-nothing 3/5), ids 100% in-scope, snap E4 50% (app half 0%). P2: isqrt edges 25%, app E10 producer 50%. Overall 79% < 80% → FAIL.
recommended_fix: Add: app-fast-path E10 replay test, px-space snap_node boundary/tie tests, non-square span_between vectors; assert mutates-nothing in all 5 rejection tests. These raise overall above 80% (P1 → ~92%, overall → ~85% → PASS).
